scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:authority: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('.test-build', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('.test-build', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('.test-build/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}\n')" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && MULTIPLAYER_DATABASE_STORE=0 MULTIPLAYER_MATCH_STORE_PATH= node --test .test-build/artifacts/api-server/test/**/*.test.js
scripts.test:authority:postgres: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) { console.error('DATABASE_URL is required for test:authority:postgres'); process.exit(1); }" && pnpm run test:authority
